name: The High Order

angles.text: Rathiril says that even adventurers without formal mage training carry strong arcane auras. Their shared magic is an inborn heritage, not only a learned discipline.
As a Skyborne, you descend from the ancient Highborne of Eldre'Thalas. You must master your arcane gifts to stand on your own now that your elemental patrons are gone.

faq.answer: Among the shen'dorei on Zephras, the High Order works for their people's survival. Founded by descendants of the Highborne of Eldre'Thalas, it seeks to wield their ancient arcane gifts so their society can defend itself and endure on its own.

Rathiril Sunlance is an elf associated with the High Order on Zephras. He teaches newcomers about local arcane energies, the shen'dorei's plight, and their resolve to survive without their former elemental patrons.

Zephras is a floating isle in Skywall where Rathiril Sunlance and his kin now live. Arcane energies fill the isle, and the shen'dorei face dangers within their people and uncertainty about their security from outside threats.
The shen'dorei are elf descendants of the Highborne from Eldre'Thalas. Now living on Zephras, they have an innate bond with arcane magic and seek to stand on their own.
The elemental benefactors were powerful elemental beings who once aided and protected the shen'dorei. They are gone, so the people of Zephras must rely on their own magic and resourcefulness.
The Al'Aketh are an internal faction or threat that endangers the shen'dorei on Zephras. The High Order organizes defenses in part to face such threats from within.

The shen'dorei's ancestors came from Eldre'Thalas, the ancient Highborne city in Kalimdor known to many in the years after the Third War as Dire Maul. The High Order honors this heritage by preserving and wielding their ancient arcane gifts.
faq.q: What is the connection between the High Order and Eldre'Thalas?

sections.body: The shen'dorei on Zephras are working to reclaim their strength and choose their own path. For a long time, elemental benefactors protected them. Now those patrons are gone, leaving the people exposed to strife within and dangers around them. Rathiril Sunlance seeks those gifted in arcane magic to help preserve their people and build their strength on their own.
sections.title: A People on Their Own

sections.body: The shen'dorei carry the legacy of Eldre'Thalas and an innate wellspring of arcane energy. Even those never formally trained in wizardry share that power. The High Order sees it as the destiny of Highborne descendants to wield these ancient gifts. With them, the shen'dorei hope to resist the Al'Aketh within and face the many threats to their home on Zephras.
sections.title: Legacy of Eldre'Thalas

summary: On Zephras, Rathiril Sunlance tells newcomers why the shen'dorei must now stand alone. Their elemental benefactors are gone, so these Highborne descendants of Eldre'Thalas turn to ancient arcane magic to protect their people.
